_readme: Keys are Instagram shortCodes — the last part of https://www.instagram.com/p/<shortCode>/.
exclude:  posts that are not a concrete project, with the reason.
merge:    a carousel and a reel about the same job → one project with photos and video.
featured: order of the projects shown first on the home page and at the top of Our work.
videos:   projects whose reel is downloaded and playable on the site (others link to Instagram).
hidden:   projects imported but not shown.
vehicleAliases: exact vehicle line from the caption → how it is written on the site.
categories: filter definitions; a project gets a category when any of its service lines matches.
summaries: optional one-sentence descriptions in both languages for the featured projects.

DdGk2B0jVI5.en: Full colour change, roof-rail wrap and rear-glass tinting.
